Genetic variance incorporates additive, epistatic dominance effects. , provided code asreml lme4 fit model genotype random effect. Note heritability estimates data balanced. Use H2() wrapper compute broad-sense heritability. wrapper three key inputs model, lme4 asreml object target, name genotype/varietal/line variable model e.g. "gen" method, method H2 calculation want. default, methods computed. title: heritable
text: Starting version 0.2.0, heritable supports heritability estimation flexibly specified mixed models, extending beyond single-environment trials. section, demonstrate heritability estimation multi-environment trial using genotype--environment (G×E) model. model contains G×E interaction, definition heritability become ambiguous interaction term can either treated nuisance variation genetic variation specific corresponding environment. illustrate address ambiguity showing calculation three heritability definitions: Conventional heritability, based genotype main effect treats G×E variation nuisance variation. Marginal heritability, defines effect genotype combination main effect G×E effects averaged across environments. Heritability calculated respect marginalised genotype effect can therefore interpreted global measure reliability average genotype performance across environments. Stratified heritability, defines effect genotype within particular environment combination main effect G×E effect environment. therefore measures reliability genotype performance within specified environment. first fit lme4 model complete lettuce dataset without subsetting single environment: random-effects expression (1 | gen * loc) expands random effects genotype, location, interaction: , call H2() (h2() narrow-sense) fitted model object. multi-environment models, following arguments control definition heritability calculated: marginal: logical specifies whether marginal heritability calculated. stratification: one-row data frame specifies environmental stratum, combination strata, within heritability estimated. stratification supplied, marginal argument determines whether conventional marginal heritability returned. stratification supplied, stratified heritability calculated specified environmental conditions. example, heritability within location L1 calculated follows:

text: following methods currently implemented narrow-sense heritability h2(method = "XX"): "Cullis": $$H^2_{Cullis} = 1 - \frac{PEV^{BLUP}_{\overline\Delta ..}}{2\sigma^2_g}$$ "Oakey": $$H^2_{Oakey} = \frac{\sum_{= n_z+1}^{n_g} \lambda_i}{\sum_{n_g}^{\lambda_i\neq 0}}$$ "Piepho": $$H^2_{Piepho} = \frac{\sigma^2_g}{\sigma^2_g + \overline{PEV_{BLUE_g}} / 2}$$ "Delta": $$H^2_{\Delta ij} = 1 - \frac{PEV^{BLUP}_{\overline\Delta ij}}{\operatorname{Var}(g_i - g_j)}$$ "Standard": $$H^2_{Standard} = \frac{\operatorname{Var}(g_i - g_j)}{\operatorname{Var}(y_i.. - y_j..)}$$ following methods currently implemented broad-sense heritability H2(method = "XX"): "Cullis": $$H^2_{Cullis} = 1 - \frac{PEV^{BLUP}_{\overline\Delta ..}}{2\sigma^2_g}$$ "Oakey": $$H^2_{Oakey} = \frac{\sum_{= n_z+1}^{n_g} \lambda_i}{\sum_{n_g}^{\lambda_i\neq 0}}$$ "Piepho": $$H^2_{Piepho} = \frac{\sigma^2_g}{\sigma^2_g + \overline{PEV_{BLUE_g}} / 2}$$ "Delta": $$H^2_{\Delta ij} = 1 - \frac{PEV^{BLUP}_{\overline\Delta ij}}{2\sigma^2_g}$$ "Standard": $$H^2_{Standard} = \frac{\sigma^2_g}{\sigma^2_g + \frac{1}{n_g}\sum_{n_g}^{=1} \sigma^2_p / n_{gi}}$$ details specific method - take look helpfile subfunctions ?H2_Cullis
